patthana23.29:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā sekho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā cha. na
patthana23.29:2.1: sekhaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevasekhonāsekho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na
patthana23.29:3.1: sekhaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca neva sekhānāsekho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā pañca na mahaggataṃ na kusalaṃ
